work.intro: These three projects represent different kinds of real use. Each case study focuses on the problem, my contribution, the technical decisions, and the limits of the result.

about.title: The work that shaped how I build
about.body1: My work sits where software development, classroom teaching, and application-security research overlap. This page gives that context without inflating the role I played.
about.body2: I build web and mobile tools that enter real workflows, and I teach years 4–6 with material designed for the constraints of a school environment.
about.body3: I also test authentication systems, document their assumptions and limitations, and publish findings that other people can inspect.

paper.title: Web Application Security Vulnerability Analysis Using Black Box Testing
paper.summary: The study treated the application as an observable attack surface rather than trusting its implementation. Ten scenarios were exercised, with the method and results preserved in a DOI-linked paper.

achievements.title: Progress and outputs that can be checked
achievements.intro: This is a working timeline, not a trophy cabinet. The emphasis is on concrete outputs, their context, and what changed after they shipped.
